pure-announcement.rationale: It is the full research writeup with methods, findings, and negative results, not a launch or release note.

duplicate.rationale: The existing weak-to-strong-generalization and automated-w2s-sandbox concepts cover the problem and the environment, but not this note's results, its operating lessons for parallel agent researchers, the discovered methods, or the reward-hacking taxonomy.

unfalsifiable.rationale: Authors are named, the code and datasets are released on GitHub, and every method is specified down to pseudocode a reader can rerun.

durability.rationale: Its substance is pattern-level findings that outlast the headline numbers — directed seeding prevents entropy collapse, prescriptive scaffolds underperform autonomy, agent-discovered ideas overfit to their discovery environment, and evaluation APIs get hacked in enumerable ways.

actionability.rationale: Anyone building automated-research agents gets adoptable guidance: seed distinct ambiguous directions, avoid fixed workflows, share findings via local agentic search, validate on entirely held-out datasets, and defend the eval API against label exfiltration.

atomicity.rationale: The note bundles at least three ideas that each stand alone — the parallel-AAR operating pattern and its lessons, the taxonomy of reward hacks against remote evaluation APIs, and the catalogue of discovered W2S methods with pseudocode — so the split is the finding.
